summary: Five places where this system is walking two metres from the cliff edge, not ten. (1) 41.3% of L0's banked evidence -- 701 of 1,696 judged claims, including 25 ledger overturns and 6 fatal-severity calls -- rests on exactly ONE critic, while GAUNTLET.md:187 mandates 3-5 lenses on a heavy lane and 'majority refute', which is undefined at n=1; RESUME_HERE.md:32 then forbids re-judging, so there is no appeal. (2) L7's gate is one human's ears (GAUNTLET.md:133, :349) while L0's own banked evidence proves the ORIGINAL SFX decrypt off disk at 11025 Hz mono with measured durations -- an objective pre-gate exists and nothing connects it, so an entire system is blocked on one person's availability by choice, not by physics. (3) Two guards fail OPEN when their input file is absent, in a repo whose standing rule is fail-closed: buildLedgerPackets.py warns and returns 0 with no lint quarantine (three lines above a conservation check that correctly returns 1), and the loop's single-writer PAUSE heartbeat is a no-op because docs/loop/PAUSE does not exist. (4) The pre-commit gate measures the true suite count on EVERY commit and buries it in /tmp, printing only a tick -- which is why two commit messages carry fabricated totals (1,002 / 1,003) that commit c38b660 had to correct to 1,001; the number was on disk, unread. (5) R1 (e97f91f) escalated an un-archived grant from art to 3,307 verbatim text lines destined for src/, twenty days after the evidence step was opened and never discharged.

findings.rule_targeted: the standing fail-closed-accounting rule (memory: feedback-fail-closed-agent-accounting), unimplemented at these two sites
findings.proposed_change: CODE ONLY, zero standing-rule words. (a) buildLedgerPackets.py: in the `if not lint_reports:` branch, keep the warning and `return 1` -- a rewrite wave that cannot be lint-quarantined must not launch 42 agents to discover it at the end. (b) Restore the single-writer interlock cheaply: change .githooks/pre-commit:18 to create the file rather than only refresh it (`touch docs/loop/PAUSE`, unconditional), so any commit re-arms the pause and build-loop.sh cannot take over behind a live session. INCIDENT (a): the author's own comment at :106 prices the miss at ~28 agents and RESUME_HERE.md now sizes that wave at 42 -- one `return 1` converts a 42-agent discovery into a 0.2-second one. INCIDENT (b): the repo's standing overnight rule is single-writer (memory: project-overnight-autonomy) and its enforcement artifact is absent from disk today. SECOND-ORDER COST: (a) a genuinely lint-free lane root (L1, L2 ... on first run) now blocks until citeLint is run there -- which is the intended behaviour, but it will be met as an unexpected red on the next lane's first packet build. (b) an unconditional touch means a stale PAUSE outlives a dead session -- already handled by build-loop.sh's 120-minute staleness takeover. ROLLBACK: one line each.

findings.claim: The pre-commit gate runs the suite and measures the true test count on every commit, then discards it into /tmp and prints only a tick -- so the one moment the measured number exists is the one moment it is hidden, which is how two commit messages came to carry fabricated totals that a later commit had to correct.
findings.evidence:
$ sed -n 28,36p .githooks/pre-commit
run_step() {  # $1 = label, $2 = command
  [ -z "$2" ] && return 0
  log="/tmp/gate-$1.log"
  if ! sh -c "$2" >"$log" 2>&1; then
    printf '\n(x) %s FAILED -- commit aborted. Last lines:\n' "$1"; tail -20 "$log"
    printf '\nFull log: %s\n' "$log"; exit 1
  fi
  printf '  ok %s\n' "$1"
}
(on SUCCESS the entire vitest summary is swallowed; only on FAILURE is any output shown)

findings.rule_targeted: .claude/ship-bar.md item 3 ('verified before claiming done/fixed/passing -- with the output PASTED, never asserted'), which today has no mechanical hook
findings.proposed_change: CODE ONLY, zero standing-rule words: in run_step's success path, echo the measured summary instead of a bare tick -- `printf '  ok %s\n' "$1"; [ "$1" = tests ] && grep -E '^\s+(Test Files|Tests)' "$log"`. The ship-bar rule then has a hook: the number is on screen, in the terminal, while the commit message is being typed. INCIDENT: 3adac1b and 8f332e9 wrote 1,002 and 1,003 into the permanent record; c38b660 measured 1,001. SECOND-ORDER COST: three extra lines of terminal noise per commit, and a number on screen invites copy-paste of a STALE count if the message is written before the hook runs -- so it is a mitigation, not a proof; the durable version is a commit-msg hook that greps the message for a test-count claim and compares it to the log. ROLLBACK: delete the appended clause.
